items.title: A house where sound mattered
items.body: Long before music became ministry, it was language. Childhood was where the ear was trained and where the first sense of something larger than talent began to settle.

items.title: Music ministry begins
items.body: The year the calling stopped being a feeling and started being a commitment. Serving on a music team turned gift into discipline and discipline into ministry.

items.title: Learning to lead worship, not perform it
items.body: Years of rehearsals, services, corrections and quiet growth — learning that the health of a worship leader off the platform determines what happens on it.

items.title: Music Director, Harvesthouse Christian Center
items.body: Serving as Music Director of Harvesthouse Christian Center, the Life Center Campus — carrying responsibility for sound, for people and for the spiritual culture a music team creates.

items.title: We Evangelise — reaching the unreached
items.body: Outreach began in partnership with non-profit and faith-based mission organisations. Seven rural communities across Ibadan have since received the Gospel, relief and practical skill acquisition programmes.

items.title: The 5AM Tribe
items.body: A community of saints committed to praying daily at 5am for at least an hour. What began as a simple commitment has grown into a place where men and women find refuge, strength and intimacy with God.

items.title: Raising ministers, not just musicians
items.body: SilentShout School of Music Ministry was born out of a gap: gifted young creatives with no framework for formation, character or responsibility.

items.title: Edwoltz Hair City
items.body: A hair business built with the same instinct — serve people well, teach what you know, and take responsibility for what your industry leaves behind.

items.title: Turning experience into frameworks
items.body: VisionCraft Academy, the Coaching Hub, The Power of 90 Days and four books — practical structures for people who want to move from intention to execution.

items.title: Gathering the threads
items.body: Music, ministry, teaching, writing and enterprise are no longer separate rooms. They are one house, and this season is about opening the doors.
